description:
Extend the DataFrame tuning system to support physical data layout options
during the write phase (Parquet generation). Currently, DataFrame tuning only
covers runtime options (threads, memory, streaming). This TODO adds write-time
physical layout control.

## Current State Analysis

### Existing DataFrame Tuning (Runtime)
The current system (`benchbox/core/dataframe/tuning/`) supports:
- **Parallelism**: thread_count, worker_count, threads_per_worker
- **Memory**: memory_limit, chunk_size, spill_to_disk, rechunk
- **Execution**: streaming_mode, engine_affinity, lazy_evaluation
- **Data Types**: dtype_backend, string_cache, auto_categorize
- **I/O**: memory_pool, memory_map, pre_buffer, row_group_size
- **GPU**: device_id, spill_to_host, pool_type

### Missing Physical Layout Options
When DataFrames write to Parquet (during data preparation), there's no
configuration for:
- **Partitioning**: Hive-style partition directories
- **Sorting**: Physical row order within files
- **Row Group Size**: Control compression/scan efficiency
- **Repartitioning**: Number of output files
- **Column Encoding**: Dictionary, RLE, bit-packing per column

## Platform Capabilities

| Platform | Partitioned Write | Sorted Write | Repartition | Row Group Size |
|----------|-------------------|--------------|-------------|----------------|
| Polars   | ✗ No              | ✓ sort()     | ✗ No        | ✓ Yes          |
| Pandas   | ✗ No              | ✓ sort_values| ✗ No        | ✓ Yes          |
| Dask     | ✓ to_parquet()    | ✗ Limited    | ✓ repartition | ✓ Yes        |
| PySpark  | ✓ partitionBy()   | ✓ sortBy()   | ✓ repartition | ✓ Yes        |
| cuDF     | ✗ No              | ✓ sort_values| ✗ No        | ✓ Yes          |
| Modin    | ✗ No              | ✓ sort_values| ✗ No        | ✓ Via Pandas   |

## Why This Matters

Physical layout affects:
1. **Query performance**: Sorted data enables skip-scanning
2. **Compression ratio**: Sorted columns compress better
3. **Partition pruning**: Hive partitions reduce scan scope
4. **Parallel reads**: Multiple files enable parallel loading
